author: eyigitba
body:
#### PR description:

This PR adds some missing keep statements to `L1Trigger_EventContent` which are required for L1 scouting reduced event content MC requests in Phase2Spring24 campaign. 

Most of these keep statements already exist in the releases that come after this one. However, a full backport of the keep statements from newer releases is not possible as it can end up crashing the emulation due to buggy producers. Therefore I only added the collections that already exist in the default `SimL1Emulator` sequence in 140X releases and that does not crash the workflows. 

In principle, this PR only affects data/MC produced with 140X releases and doesn't need to be ported to another release. But if you prefer to have these changes propagated I can also do that. 


#### PR validation:

Validated by rerunning step2 and step3 `cmsDriver` commands from Phase2Spring24 MC campaign and making sure that the added collections now appear in the final event content and the necessary L1 scouting re-emulation jobs can run on this final root file. 

#### If this PR is a backport please specify the original PR and why you need to backport that PR. If this PR will be backported please specify to which release cycle the backport is meant for:
title: [14_0_X] [L1T] Adding missing keep statements to L1T event content definitions
